payload.core_mechanism_summary: Maintains sum of binomial coefficients C(i+1, j) for j≤k where k=t-sum(a). Updates sum in O(1) amortized using doubling and subtraction of excess terms when k decreases.
payload.rationale: The solution iteratively computes the CDF of a binomial distribution, using an amortized two-pointer technique to update the sum of binomial coefficients in linear total time.
